text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It's the last day of summer camp for<n>the senior
racers. The bus to take us<n>back to the academy is
parked out<n>front.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Sigh... I can't believe summer camp isover already, but I know we gave itour best.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, you look pretty sleepy, Trainer.<n>You should
rest up on the ride home.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Yawn... I hope you don't mind if I doas well.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide gets on the bus. I'm<n>about to follow
her on but pause<n>when a nearby conversation
catches<n>my attention.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text: Did you get a look at Narita Brian's<n>training?

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer
text_block_list.text: I sure did. I can't believe how fast<n>she is.

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer
text_block_list.text:
The most unbelievable part is how<n>she's still
dissatisfied with her<n>growth despite how much
she's<n>already improved. That's the sign of
someone with real potential.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. She's going to be a real beast.<n>And to think
she'll be participating in<n>the Arima Kinen in just six
months...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It won't be long before Narita Brian<n>catches all the
way up to us...
